bullets.text: Merged PRs took a median 7.3 days from ready for review to merge; the slowest 10% took over 64 days.
For merged PRs, reaching a reviewer lgtm took a median 4.1 days and 1 in 10 took about 49 days or longer; once both review labels were set the median merge time was 1.7 hours.
Across the repo, 272 open PRs remain without any human response and have a median wait of 41 days in that queue.
There are 368 open PRs waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm with a median wait of 69 days, and 231 of those 368 (63%) are labeled for sig/api-machinery or sig/node.
By team queue, sig/api-machinery has 120 PRs waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm with a median wait of 85 days, making it the largest by total waiting in that stage.
